entry.title: The 99 Names of Allah - part (01)
entry.summary: "Asmaa Allah Al-Husna" is a visual art series inspired by the meanings of selected Names of Allah. The project aims to present a contemporary artistic vision that goes beyond traditional Arabic calligraphy, using colors, shapes, and natural elements to create unique visual compositions. Each artwork explores an individual concept inspired by the meaning of a name, inviting reflection and contemplation while maintaining a cohesive artistic identity throughout the series.

مشروع »أسماء الله الحسنى« هو سلسلة من الأعمال الفنية البصرية المستوحاة من معاني مجموعة مختارة من أسماء الله الحسنى. يسعى المشروع إلى تقديم رؤية فنية معاصرة تتجاوز الشكل التقليدي للخط العربي، من خلال توظيف الألوان والأشكال والعناصر الطبيعية لابتكار تكوينات بصرية تحمل كل منها فكرة مستقلة تعبّر عن المعنى المستوحى من الاسم، وتدعو إلى التأمل والتدبر، ضمن هوية فنية مترابطة تجمع جميع الأعمال.

entry.title: temet - character design & visual development
entry.summary:
Temet is an animated series project developed through character design and visual development, with a mysterious, gothic atmosphere at its core.
For this project, I worked on the development of the main cast, exploring silhouettes, proportions, expressions, gestures and colour to define distinct personalities and establish a cohesive visual language.
The designs are built around the darker and more mysterious side of the world of Temet, balancing gothic influences with expressive, character-driven design and a visual language suited to animation.
The project includes character lineups, gesture and expression studies, and colour development.
